how_to_read: Each question is tested by several papers, one row per paper, oldest first. Each row is an atlas record (its quote is in atlas_data.json and agent/records/) with the paper's answer (yes, partly or no), a short finding, and the setting it was tested in; every finding and setting cites the exact words. 'differences' say what differs between the papers' settings. 'results' gives every result and main claim a status: holds (every other paper on its question finds the same), conflicts (every other paper finds otherwise), mixed, or once (no other paper in the atlas tests it yet; this does not mean wrong).
